gemini.title: Boundary Census Volunteers Bua
gemini.abstract: Boundary Census Volunteers Bua is an authoritative dataset published by Central Statistics Office Ireland. It represents boundary census volunteers bua features using geometry geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Central Statistics Office Ireland as open statistics and census data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: guid
columns.description: UUID-formatted identifier associated with the record; persistence across releases is not confirmed.

columns.name: geogid
columns.description: Code identifying the geographical area represented by the row.

columns.name: geogdesc
columns.description: Name or descriptive label of the geographical area represented by the row.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
